Analista de Desenvolvimento Back-End Pleno

Somos a Base Exchange, a futura nova Bolsa de Valores do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro.

Por meio de uma infraestrutura de ponta, desenvolvida em parceria com a Flowa Technologies, a Base visa ampliar o mercado de capitais do país, trazendo mais uma opção para que empresas e investidores façam seus negócios com transparência, agilidade e tecnologia. Buscamos uma constante parceria com nossos clientes, mantendo um relacionamento próximo e pautado pela confiança.

Nosso time é qualificado e movido pelo compromisso incansável com a excelência e inovação. Somos guiados pela tecnologia e foco no cliente, com um espírito inquieto e uma visão transformadora. Buscamos tornar o mercado de capitais mais dinâmico, acessível e conectado, criando oportunidades que impulsionam a mudança e fortalecem a economia.

No seu dia a dia você irá atuar com:

  • Participar ativamente no desenvolvimento de produtos desde a concepção até a implantação e o acompanhamento em produção;
  • Contribuir na modelagem e na evolução de nossas soluções, respondendo a requisitos de performance e robustez, entre outros;
  • Trabalhar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de componentes para a nova bolsa, clearing e autorregulação;
  • Atuar com as tecnologias: C#, SQL, Redis, Kafka, MongoDB.

O que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Computação, Eletrônica, Sistemas de Informação, Informática ou área técnica relacionada;
  • Sólidos fundamentos de ciência da computação (teoria, estruturas de dados e algoritmos);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET/C#;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em uma equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Experiência em equipes de desenvolvimento de produtos em ambiente ágil.

Serão considerados como diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento front-end e React;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimentos relacionados ao mercado financeiro e/ou experiência anterior nesse segmento.

Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro brasileiro, vem com a gente!

We are looking for a proactive, collaborative community manager to help shape Uber's newest engineering center in Rio de Janeiro and grow the tech ecosystem in Brazil.

Uber is committed to the tech scene in Brazil and Latin America! The Rio de Janeiro Tech Office is Uber's newest engineering center. We're expecting to hire more than 200 engineers, and this role will be essential to attract the best talent in the region.

About The Role

We are expanding our product range from the base operating system – Ubuntu – to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long‑term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long‑term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do — at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer — a real understanding of customer needs, industry‑specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect — the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology — a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork — a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy — the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow‑up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account winsSelf‑discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

About The Role

Product Marketing Manager - Production Services

Fictiv exists to help product innovators create.

Fictiv is a global manufacturing and supply chain company that enables organizations to scale globally across Fictiv's four global manufacturing centers in India, Mexico, China, and the U.S. Companies use Fictiv to access high-quality production, optimize supply chain logistics, and mitigate supply chain risk—ensuring they can move from prototype to full-scale manufacturing with speed and confidence. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 35 million commercial and prototype parts for industries such as aerospace, robotics, automotive, climate tech, and more, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.

Impact In This Role

Fictiv is looking for a Product Marketing Manager - Production Services with a passion for production manufacturing and supply chain industry to join our marketing team. In this role, you will empower your marketing colleagues and sales key stakeholders with the market information, messages, proof points, and content to effectively promote our product offerings. You will know the ins-and-outs of who our target customers are, what they care about, and what manufacturing and supply chain services they need at every stage of the product life cycle - especially bridge to full-scale production. You will package this information into powerful messages and assets to win the hearts and minds of Fictiv's customers, partners and industry analysts.

This position reports to the Senior Director of Product Marketing.

  • Developing clear and effective production manufacturing solution messaging by persona and industry vertical to be used in marketing and sales campaigns

  • Interacting with customers and Fictiv sales reps to document win/loss analysis and deepen our understanding of our target audience
  • Evaluating Fictiv's positioning against our competition to inform our positioning and accentuate its differentiation in the market
  • Directing launch campaigns to promote new feature releases and services
  • Delivering clear messaging for emails, ads, web landing pages, brochures and technical positioning to support marketing campaigns and SEO initiatives
  • Enabling our sales teams with product trainings and sales enablement materials
  • Identifying case studies and testimonials that provide clear, quantifiable examples of Fictiv's value

Desired Traits

  • 10+ years experience in global manufacturing and supply chain, sales and/or product marketing roles
  • B.S. in engineering or B.A. in business, marketing or other relevant field
  • You are a strategic thinker, able to translate complex ideas into clear, focused actions and solutions
  • You are an excellent writer, comfortable developing blogs, brochures, and landing page copy
  • You are highly organized and a great project manager, able to keep multiple stakeholders on track toward a launch deadline
  • Comfortable working in a marketing shared services, matrix-driven model
  • Experience marketing to a span of personas such as technical audiences (e.g., mechanical engineers) and senior-level executives (e.g., manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, operations)

  • BONUS POINTS: You've worked with technology products that have targeted mechanical engineers, manufacturing, supply chain and procurement managers. An understanding of mechanical or electronic manufacturing processes across North America and overseas is a plus.

A family-owned company, bioMérieux has grown to become a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics . Come and join a family-owned global company with a long-term vision, and a human-centered culture.

Mission Overview

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will lead the Compensation & Benefits strategy for Latin America, ensuring internal equity, external competitiveness, and support for business transformation, while maintaining consistency with global practices, adapting to local needs, and maintaining an employee value proposition that remains consistent and attractive across Latin America.

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will report to the Sr. Director, Human Resources - Latin America.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Trend Monitoring
    • Stay updated on compensation and benefits practices in the region to maintain competitiveness.
    • Conduct and analyze external compensation surveys and market trends to develop innovative compensation initiatives and manage cyclical activities such as open enrollment
  • Bridge Between Global and Regional Teams and Business Leaders
    • Act as a liaison between the global compensation team and regional leaders, translating business needs into appropriate policies and programs.
    • Partner with managers to define compensation packages that ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
    • Train HRBPs and leaders on C&B practices, career ranges, and JA as a tool for dialogue and development.
    • Support Transformation Projects in the region (integrations, restructures, new businesses), ensuring pay/benefits structures enable change.

    • Support or coordinate the region’s participation in market surveys according to local practices.

    • Ensure adherence to Job Architecture (families, streams, levels, profiles) as the foundation for pay structures, career paths, and communication.

  • Benefits & Total Rewards
    • Map, benchmark, and optimize benefits packages (health, life, meal, transportation, mobility, wellness, retirement), balancing harmonization and local customization across Latin America.
    • Manage vendors and administrators (negotiation, SLAs, quality, employee experience) and lead flex benefits projects
  • Policy Communication and Implementation
    • Guarantee that global, regional, and Local policies are communicated and applied correctly, including merit cycles, inflation, benefits, promotions, and incentive programs.
    • Implement and develop Regional policies aligned with global practices.
    • Reviewed and validated the local policies, ensuring that they are aligned with the Global policies and strategies.
  • Support Global Compensation Philosophy
    • Contribute to the execution of global strategies, including short- and long-term incentive programs, equity plans, and process governance .
    • Lead the design and end-to-end management of compensation programs, including salary adjustments, inflation, bonuses, and rewards, benefits ensuring strategic alignment and compliance.

Studies & Experiences

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Psychology, or related; MBA/post-grad preferred.
  • Expected 8–12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, with multi-country LATAM exposure.
  • Expertise in Job Architecture, job evaluation/levelling, and market pricing with global providers.
  • Experience in managing pay structures, incentives (STI/LTI), mobility, benefits, and compensation analytics, and tools and benchmarks (Mercer, WTW, CompAnalyst), Excel/BI, HRIS/ERP systems.

Soft Skills

  • Analytical thinking & synthetic mindset
  • Leader by Influence

  • Ability to work in a matrix environment with cross-cultural flexibility ;
  • Problem-solving and teamwork abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative & out-of-the-box thinker
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Leadership and communication – Assertiveness.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • ethics/confidentiality

Language

Fluent in Spanish and English. Portuguese will be a plus.

Working Conditions

This role could be a hybrid model or home office model.

Location

The position could be based in any subsidiary of Latin America, such as Brasil, México, Chile, Colombia and Argentina.

title: Inspection Supervisor - Brazil (#622)
description:
Our Core Values are at the heart of who we are, and everything we do….

People.

Planet.

Product.

Motive Offshore Group specialises in the design, manufacture, rental, and inspection of marine and lifting equipment and are committed to delivering sustainable, innovative and multisector solutions and we require highly skilled individuals, like you, to come and be part of our journey.

We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach and capabilities, in particular with the low carbon and energy transition areas. We aim to assist our clients and suppliers to join us as we move in to the more sustainable world.

Most importantly, our People are our most valuable asset here at the Motive Offshore Group and we encourage an inclusive, innovative and collaborative workplace that allows our employees & candidates to positively work towards their career potential.

About the role:

Hours: Full-time

The Inspection Supervisor will be responsible for leading and supervising all inspection, NDT, and rope access activities. The role includes ensuring full compliance with IRATA Level III rigging and safety requirements. Duties involve planning, coordinating, and carrying out routine and periodic surveys using the full range of NDT methods and inspection equipment. Onsite training, mentoring, and performance oversight for Inspectors also form a key part of the position. Responsibilities further include undertaking all tasks associated with a Level III Rope Access Supervisor.

The position requires ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards. Additional responsibilities include supporting continuous improvement initiatives and contributing to the development and implementation of inspection procedures and best practices.

This role offers a rewarding opportunity to work in the offshore sector, with the chance to operate industry‑leading equipment and collaborate with skilled teams, while taking on a varied and challenging role that allows you to make a meaningful impact every day.

About the team:

As a part of our Brazil team, you’ll become part of a small, hardworking, and skilled team who work to a high standard and specification. Reporting to the Operations Manager for Brazil, you'll also become part of the wider America's team and be supported by our team of onshore and offshore personnel working alongside you, whose goal, much like your own, will be to enable a quick and safe turn‑around of equipment.

And you’ll be working alongside a committed and proud Motive team in the UK and globally that want to play their part in the growth of the business and support each other daily to create a positive, values driven and hard‑working professional environment.

Responsibilities:

People

  • Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensuring their use is embedded throughout.
  • Develop strong working relations with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues etc.
  • To be a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd.
  • To uphold the Motive Offshore Group People Values.

Planet

  • Lead by example in setting the highest possible standards in the promotion of People Values, HSEQ procedures and best practice, ensuring compliance to the Motive Offshore Group HSEQ Policy, procedures, standards and regulatory obligations.
  • Immediately report all accidents, incidents, near misses or environmental concerns.
  • Adhere to and participate in company‑wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.

Product

  • To provide Rope Access supervision, advice and support.
  • To perform Rope Access activities.
  • Perform the role of Level III Rope Access Supervisor and carry out various rope access works such as NDT, structural installations, and removals, shot blasting and painting in a safe and efficient manner. Rig up and inspect rope access equipment prior to and during use.
  • Carry out routine surveys, inspections and load testing of Lifting equipment and their accessories and the immediate reporting of defects or concerns.
  • Maintain the compilation of all hours undertaken for rope access activities, report findings to rope access manager.
  • Mentor other Spooling and Inspection Rope Access Technicians.
  • Ensure all rope access equipment is maintained.
  • Attend rope access refresher and other associated training as required.
  • Where qualified, carry out visual and NDT examination of all types and construction of high‑performance wire rope.
  • Where qualified, carry out pressure lubrication of all types of high‑performance wire ropes in accordance with working procedures and COSHH Assessments.
  • Complete Daily Client Service Record, Rope Access forms in full, with accurate times and descriptions obtaining signed approval from the client where required.
  • Proper set up of equipment.
  • Use of Kinetic Software for the review, approval and production of good quality inspection reports ready to send to customers.
  • Travelling to worldwide destinations as and when required.

Required skills / knowledge:

  • Significant offshore experience.
  • Suitable NDT certification (SNT or PCN Level II).
  • IRATA Rope Access Level III.
  • Offshore certification.
  • Experience operating machinery.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
  • Ability to prioritise.
  • Strong organisation skills with a good ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.
  • Ability to cope with change in a busy working environment.

What we can offer you:

Working with Motive can take you places that you might not have thought possible. Every region we operate in, bring their own wonderful cultures & ways of working. And as a global business, you will become colleagues with people not only in the UK, but also in Taiwan, Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and in the US. You can look forward to becoming part of our people‑centred approach that sees us work closely together, supporting clients and projects in multiple countries across the world.

People are at the heart of everything we do and we’re incredibly proud of the development opportunities that many of our staff have benefitted from. Since we started in 2010, we’ve seen school leavers work their way to senior positions, people relocate to other parts of the world and countless colleagues develop skills, receive training and advance their technical knowledge to enhance their own career, which in turn helps us continuously improve as a business, an employer and carry out the services we have become renowned for. At Motive, we believe in growing together. We are One Team, One Motive, and your journey is part of our shared success.

How to Apply & what happens next:

You’re happy and ready to apply? Great, thank you.

You can apply by sending us a CV with any supporting documents telling us why you’d like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group.

We want to find great people and learn more about you as a person, ensuring we all have a positive recruitment journey. So please, tell us more about you, however you’d want.

Once we’ve reviewed your application, we’ll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages of the process. If you have any questions about the role or want to chat about what life is like at Motive Offshore Group, email us at

Hi there! We are South, and our client is looking for an SEO Content Writer!

About the Company

Our client is a fast‑growing digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, content strategy, and organic growth. They partner with brands across SaaS, e‑commerce, tech, and professional services, helping them scale their online presence through high‑impact, data‑driven content.

The agency values creativity, innovation, and a modern content production workflow that blends AI efficiency with human craftsmanship to deliver top‑tier SEO performance.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled SEO Content Writer to create high‑quality, search‑optimized content across multiple client campaigns. This is a full‑time, remote role for someone who knows how to use AI tools for drafting—but relies on excellent human editing skills to ensure all final content is original, accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand voice.

You will collaborate with SEO strategists to produce blog posts, guides, landing pages, and long‑form resources designed to increase organic traffic, rankings, and conversions. Success in this role comes from strong research ability, mastery of on‑page SEO, exceptional editing skills, and the capacity to manage multiple deadlines within a fast‑paced agency environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Creation & Editing
    • Research topics and generate initial content drafts using AI tools, refining them with deep human edits for originality, accuracy, tone, and SEO alignment.
    • Produce SEO‑optimized content that naturally incorporates primary and long‑tail keywords, metadata, internal linking, and other on‑page best practices.
    • Adapt AI‑generated drafts to match the client brand voice, audience needs, and industry context.
  • SEO Optimization & Performance
    • Analyze performance data (via tools like Google Analytics, Ahrefs, or SEMrush) and iterate on content to improve rankings and engagement.
    • Review and elevate underperforming content through updated research, stronger messaging, and human‑edited enhancements.
    • Stay updated on SEO trends, algorithm updates, and AI advancements in content production.
  • Content Workflow Management
    • Manage content pipelines, including AI‑generated outlines, human editing, publishing within CMS platforms (WordPress), and coordinating internal/external approvals.
    • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and brand alignment across all written assets.
    • Collaborate with SEO strategists and creative teams to refine content direction and messaging.
  • Collaboration & Ideation
    • Participate in content brainstorming sessions and use AI tools for rapid ideation.
    • Suggest new topic opportunities based on keyword research and SERP trends.
    • Apply human curation to ensure all ideas are aligned with client goals and search intent.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in SEO content writing, preferably within an agency environment.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools for drafting (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper, Claude) combined with strong human editing ability.
  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content clustering, and on‑page optimization.
  • Experience publishing content in WordPress; Elementor knowledge is a plus.
  • Strong research skills and ability to translate AI‑generated information into polished, accurate, value‑driven content.
  • Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Keyword Planner.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to adapt tone and style across industries.

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of technical SEO elements (schema, E‑E‑A‑T, etc.).
  • Experience writing for SaaS, e‑commerce, or tech clients.
  • Basic design abilities using tools like Canva for simple graphics.
  • Knowledge of content performance metrics and A/B content testing.
  • Ability to analyze AI vs. human‑edited outcomes to improve workflows.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote & flexible work environment.
  • Competitive salary in USD.
  • Opportunity to work with diverse clients and shape high‑impact SEO strategies.
  • Professional development in both AI‑assisted content creation and advanced SEO.
  • Collaborative environment that encourages creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

We asked ourselves — What if better care didn't cost more? That's why we built Vitable: the health benefits platform making healthcare better for employers of everyday workers. We bring accessible, high-quality care to over 85 million uninsured and underinsured Americans. Unlike traditional options, our suite of health benefits is designed with real people at the center. Vitable empowers businesses to become better employers by making it easy to offer healthcare benefits to their teams. It's a better experience for employees and a smarter solution for employers. Simply put, we're built for better. We're growing rapidly and looking for eager team members who are hungry for change and passionate about delivering better care to the everyday worker. Does that sound like you?

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced (Senior) Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable data systems, partnering cross‑functionally, and elevating data maturity across an organization. You will design, build, and maintain our data pipelines, models, and infrastructure while ensuring high reliability, data quality, and strong alignment with business needs.

What You’ll Do

Set Vision & Partner With the Business

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, and Finance teams to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Assess our current data environment, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to support long‑term growth.

Architect & Build Data Infrastructure

  • Design, develop, and maintain reliable, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption layers.
  • Build and manage our data models and transformations using dbt with strong testing and documentation practices.
  • Implement best‑in‑class data governance, quality checks, lineage, and observability.

Hands‑On Execution

  • Write production‑grade Python/SQL, debug complex issues, improve pipeline performance, and ensure data accuracy and reliability.
  • Work across multiple data sources and systems, integrating internal and external data as needed.

Technical Leadership & Best Practices

  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technology selection, and data engineering standards.
  • Help mentor and support future data team members as we scale.
  • Advocate for data‑driven decision making across the organization.

Cross‑Functional Impact

  • Build metrics and dashboards that support critical business needs, including operational insights, clinical analytics, funnel conversion, cost modeling, and financial reporting.
  • Ensure data requirements are incorporated early into product and operations workflows to reduce rework and improve adoption.
  • Partner with Security/Compliance to ensure data processes meet SOC2 and HIPAA‑adjacent requirements.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Technical Strength

  • 5+ years of data engineering or analytics engineering experience designing and maintaining scalable, reliable data solutions.
  • Strong proficiency with dbt and modern ELT workflows.
  • Extensive experience with ETL/ELT techniques (batch + streaming).
  • Expertise with cloud platforms such as AWS (S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda), GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage), or Azure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Java.
  • Deep SQL proficiency across relational and NoSQL systems.

Professional Qualities

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into straightforward business insights.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently with ambiguity.
  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and influence systems and process improvements.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Bonus Points

  • Experience with data governance, quality frameworks, or metadata management tools.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized workflows.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK).
  • Experience supporting SOC2 or HIPAA compliance.
  • Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience preparing datasets for ML use cases.

Benefits and Perks

  • 100% Silver Plan + Full Medical Coverage
  • Dental and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) and Life Insurance
  • Access to Vitable’s Primary Care membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote‑first culture with a supportive team
  • MacBook and any other gear you need
  • Mentorship opportunities through First Round Capital
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Competitive equity package

Who Thrives Here

You care. About people, about purpose, and about doing work that matters. You're the kind of person who sees a broken system and asks, "How can I fix this?" You're not afraid of a challenge—in fact, you're energized by it. You move fast, but you think things through. You don't just get things done; you get the right things done.

At Vitable, we thrive on autonomy and collaboration. That means you have the space to own your work, make smart decisions, and lead with initiative, but you also know when to pull others in, ask questions, and work as a team.

You’ll fit right in if you’re:

  • Motivated by mission
  • Someone who gets sh*t done (and does it well)
  • Curious, thoughtful, and clear on your "why"
  • A self‑starter who can figure things out
  • Empathetic, honest, and genuinely care about others
  • Collaborative, but confident in working independently
  • Hungry for change—and ready to help make it happen

We care deeply about the people we serve, and we care about our team just as much. We support each other, we show up with heart, and we have fun while we do it.

No egos, no jerks. Just good humans doing great work.

Inclusion at Vitable

Vitable is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences—and we’re committed to building a team that reflects the people we serve.

If you’re excited about this role but your background doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We care more about potential and passion than checking every box.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Field Service Engineer

Harmonic is the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, shaping the next generation of multigigabit connectivity.

Role Description

The Field Service Engineer provides on-site installation, testing, troubleshooting, and customer support for Harmonic’s cOS virtual CMTS. This is a full-time contract position for 6–12 months.

Location

Central / South America – Hybrid role with 25–75% travel.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Install, test, and troubleshoot DAA systems, IP networks, and headend infrastructure.
  • Build and audit headend subsystems, including installing/terminating coax, Cat5/Cat6, and fiber.
  • Configure and verify headend equipment; perform system checks and diagnostics.
  • Use RF and DOCSIS meters to test and certify installations.
  • Complete documentation, test reports, and update network records.
  • Train customers on system operation and maintenance.
  • Act as an on-site liaison, identifying when issues should be routed to Sales, Support, or Engineering.
  • Follow safety procedures; lift up to 40 lbs.; work on ladders and variable schedules (including nights).

What You Should Have

  • At least 3 years of related field technician/engineering experience and an Associate’s Degree.
  • Mechanical aptitude for equipment installation and cabling work.
  • Experience in Linux at an administrative level.
  • Network troubleshooting – CCNA/CCNP, and container knowledge.
  • Basic knowledge of DOCSIS, fiber installation, and server/switch configuration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and customer-facing communication.
  • Ability to lift 30–40 lbs and work on a ladder.
  • Willingness to learn.
  • Fluent Spanish speaker (required).

Travel (if Applicable)

Central / South America hybrid role – you will be required to travel approximately 25–75%.

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion at Harmonic Inc

At Harmonic, we believe that building and nurturing a global team with diverse backgrounds and voices is critical to our success.

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Purpose

You support the effective management and optimization of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analyzing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition‑based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams. You play a key role in troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and guiding the technical team in making informed decisions to prevent failures, enhance equipment lifespan, and support safe and efficient operations.

Responsibilities

  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition‑Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors.
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health.
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support the issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew.
  • You are responsible for input actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • You should follow up on recommendations execution and effectiveness.
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).
  • You set up pre‑warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions.
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritize repairs for identified equipment deficiencies.
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analyzing vibration data and other key machine parameters.
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life extension evaluations).
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts.
  • You provide technical assistance for root cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

  • High level of safety awareness and good sense of economics.

  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFiExperience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

(2025) BR - R&I - Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva - L'Oréal Pesquisa & Inovação

A L'Oréal nasceu da ciência, criada pelas mãos e visão de um químico. Desde então, a ciência permaneceu no coração da nossa missão como empresa. O nosso principal objetivo é: inovar para promover o melhor da ciência e criar experiências de beleza inigualáveis para nossas marcas e consumidores. Nosso mindset é orientado para trabalhar com uma inovação aberta e colaborativa. Fazer parte dos nossos times de ciência e tecnologia significa constuir um mundo onde a humanidade e a natureza prosperam juntos. Então venha com a gente expandir os limites da Ciência e da Tecnologia.

Você é apaixonado pelos diferentes sentidos, e curioso pela ciência por trás de um produto e seu impacto nos sentidos e emoções humanas? Você é um líder inspirador, que tem a habilidade de liderar mudanças e desenvolver talentos na área de ciência sensorial e cognitiva? Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, esta é a posição que vai brilhar seus olhos e despertar suas sensações e emoções!

Estamos buscando uma liderança inovadora que tem visão de longo prazo e paixão por ciência sensorial para levar o time de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva (Evaluation Intelligence) a outro nível. A posição de Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva na América Latina na L’Oréal é responsável por liderar um time inovador e orientado por resultados com forte conhecimento em análise sensorial, que contribui para todas as categorias em Latam (Hair care, Color e Skin care).

Essa posição vai liderar o time de forma estratégica, ajudando no desenvolvimento de produtos com visão holística de performance e experiência do consumidor pela caracterização sensorial e entendimento de comportamentos e emoções. Essa posição reportará diretamente para a Head de Evaluation Intelligence Latam e será parte do seu Mancom/time de liderança.

Principais Atividades

  • Liderar e implementar o Roadmap e Objetivos da Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva para a organização
  • Liderar um grupo de analistas, técnicos e coordenadores (13+) e ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento do time em Ciência Sensorial & Cognitiva, Data, Digital & Tech
  • Liderar a compreensão sensorial aprofundada de nossos principais produtos, concorrentes e inovações atuais
  • Liderar com a equipe a comunicação dos principais e mais estratégicos resultados sensoriais/cognitivos de projetos para orientar a decisão de negócios
  • Construir uma organização efetiva e com recrutamento e retenção de pessoas chave para o time, promovendo o trabalho colaborativo e uma cultura diversa e inclusiva
  • Liderar esforços para promover diversidade e inclusão em todas as metodologias e estudos, garantindo que atendamos às necessidades de todos os consumidores em sua imensa diversidade
  • Ser responsável pela melhor avaliação sensorial & cognitiva da categoria, para responder a perguntas de desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecendo resultados que ajudarão a aprimorar conceitos, tecnologias e fórmulas
  • Permanecer atualizado sobre questões específicas da indústria e novas técnicas de avaliação sensorial/cognitiva e manter relacionamentos externos para identificar potenciais colaboradores para a exploração de novas metodologias
  • Implementar e desenvolver estratégias para atividades de publicação científica, transformação de aprendizados em melhores práticas internas e entrega desses aprendizados à rede global da L'Oréal
  • Ser pioneiro em novas tecnologias de aprimoramento sensorial para entender melhor o consumidor e a percepção/desempenho de produtos, utilizando ferramentas como realidade aumentada/virtual, ciência comportamental, IA e interação humano-computador, etc.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os parceiros da L'Oréal para construir relacionamentos de alta qualidade com as partes interessadas para garantir objetivos claros do projeto, alinhamento, crescimento e entrega de valor como uma equipe integrada
  • Liderar colaborações locais e globais dentro de Evaluation Intelligence, L'Oréal R&I Hubs e parceiros externos para desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas de painel sensorial, novas formas de trabalho e metodologias sensoriais/cognitivas

Requisitos

  • Mestrado/PhD em Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia, Química, Ciências Sociais, Psicologia ou áreas afins com mais de 10 anos de pesquisa sensorial/cognitiva, de consumo e de produtos em uma função estratégica
  • Ter experiência em liderar pessoas, com sucesso demonstrado no desenvolvimento e construção de uma equipe de alto desempenhoExperiência de trabalho em um ambiente multicultural internacional e capacidade de pensar globalmente
  • Forte habilidade com pessoas, trabalho colaborativo e formação de equipes multidisciplinares, além de habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação (escrita/oral) e com diplomacia e poder de influência
  • Capacidade de fornecer insights claros por meio da análise de conjuntos de dados múltiplos/complexos com experiência em análise sensorial/cognitiva, experiência do usuário, Design thinking e comunicação visual
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de desenvolvimento de inovação, sensorial e insights do consumidor
  • Conhecimento e paixão por beleza, cosméticos, dispositivos e tecnologia digital são a vantagem
  • Deve ser proficiente em Outlook, Word, PowerPoint e Excel

Habilidades

  • Orientado para as pessoas, acessível e empático(a)
  • Pessoa curiosa e visionária
  • Impulsionador(a) por ideias disruptivas e inovadoras
  • Flexível, ágil, proativo(a) e pragmático(a)
  • Detalhista e organizado(a)

O Consultor SAP PS Regulatório Sênior será o dono funcional do desenho de obras e projetos regulatórios, assegurando aderência às SAP Best Practices, Clean Core, universal journal e integrações com portfólio de ativos e obras de rede. title: Web Analyst Specialist
description:

About Us

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.
  • At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands‑on.
  • Pre‑IPO & growing – We’re backed by leading VC funds, funding ~€400m to date. Now we’re focused on profitability and IPO preparation. It’s an exciting time to join us.
  • ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long‑term success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, HubSpot).
  • Set and ideate web events based on business objectives.
  • Conduct A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyze audience segments to improve targeting and personalization.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviors.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data‑driven insights that inform content creation and optimize engagement from key user segments.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to interpret web data using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behavior tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Additional Information

Hiring Process

  1. Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper dive into your experience and aspirations with your future manager.
  3. Case Study – A practical exercise to present to the Hiring Managers.
  4. Reference Check & Offer.

Benefits

  • Healthcare insurance.
  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support.

title: Enfermeira Assistencial  - Botafogo
description:
Vitus Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Espirito Santo e Ceará realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores.

Valores

Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupamos em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar atendimento assistencial ao paciente, incluindo acolhimento, orientação e monitoramento durante toda a permanência no centro de infusão.
  • Executar triagem clínica, avaliação inicial e confirmação de critérios de elegibilidade para realização da terapia prescrita.
  • Preparar, administrar e monitorar terapias intravenosas, subcutâneas ou intramusculares, respeitando protocolos e boas práticas.
  • Realizar punção venosa periférica.
  • Prevenir, identificar, avaliar e intervir nos incidentes relacionados aos medicamentos e a outros problemas da assistência ao paciente.
  • Monitorar sinais vitais, identificar e intervir em eventos adversos relacionados à infusão, acionando equipe médica quando necessário.
  • Checar a receita, e dose prescrita antes do início do atendimento ao paciente.
  • Realizar e registrar a SAE de acordo com os protocolos institucionais e necessidades do paciente.
  • Registrar todas as ações assistenciais em prontuário eletrônico, garantindo rastreabilidade, completude e conformidade com normas regulatórias.
  • Utilizar e fazer bom uso dos recursos institucionais (equipamentos, materiais, instalações e EPI's), comunicando problemas ou alterações ao superior imediato.
  • Orientar e auxiliar pacientes e cuidadores quanto à assistência prestada.
  • Participar sempre que solicitado em reuniões, comissões e núcleos institucionais.
  • Desenvolver, em colaboração com os demais membros da equipe Multidisciplinar, ações para a promoção, proteção e recuperação da saúde, e a qualidade de vida.
  • Auxiliar na cobertura de escalas de férias, folgas e/ou intercorrências do enfermeiro assistencial na unidade quando necessário.
  • Realizar atendimento domiciliar, para aplicação de medicamentos subcutâneos e intramusculares sempre que necessário.

Responsabilidades Institucionais

  • Acolher e cuidar do ser humano, sendo sensível às suas necessidades individuais e coletivas, no aspecto físico, mental, social e espiritual.
  • Agir com foco na melhoria contínua nas interfaces de processos, alcançando resultados que superam as expectativas.
  • Antecipar aos problemas e buscar realizar as atividades de forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.
  • Ser proativo para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumindo responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-las para outros.

Formação: Graduação em Enfermagem com registro profissional ativo.

Desejável:

Pós-graduação em Oncologia.

Experiência prévia em Terapia Assistida.

  • Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança do paciente;

  • Manejo de reações adversas.

Sabemos do nosso importante papel de transformação na sociedade, entendendo que aspessoas são fundamentais na trajetória de crescimento, ao lado dos resultados, internacionalização, inovação e sustentabilidade, para nos tornarmos cada vez mais globais. A Toledo do Brasil, cumprindo a legislação e com o intuito de contribuir como solução para um cenário atual desafiador para a juventude e promover a evolução da força de trabalho no Brasil, está buscando jovens para fazer parte de nosso time de Jovens Aprendizes.

O curso de Aprendizagem Industrial Eletricista de Manutenção Eletroeletrônica tem por objetivo proporcionar qualificação profissional na instalação e manutenção de sistemas eletroeletrônicos em baixa tensão, de acordo com normas técnicas, de qualidade, de saúde e segurança no trabalho e de meio ambiente.

Você já entrou em um lugar pela primeira vez e logo de cara se sentiu em casa? Bom, é essa sensação que a Toledo do Brasil quer proporcionar a todos os colaboradores. Você pode não saber, mas com certeza já conhece um pouco a empresa : talvez tenha visto um de nossos produtos em uma padaria, enquanto espera os frios serem fatiados e pesados; no supermercado; na estrada; ou até mesmo naquela rápida parada na farmácia. Lembrou? Sim, sem dúvida você já viu um desses produtos espalhados por todo o Brasil ou América Latina.

Agora, o que você talvez não saiba ainda é que nós somos muito mais que balança . Hoje somos reconhecidos como uma empresa de tecnologia, que desenvolve softwares, cria plataformas de produtos e serviços em cloud e revende etiquetas eletrônicas e fatiadores de carne e frios.

E se você soubesse agora que, além de investir em alta tecnologia e inovação, a empresa em que você pretende trabalhar promove para seus colaboradores festivais de música em local e com equipamentos profissionais, campeonatos de videogame que mais parecem reunião entre amigos, que possui o “Espaço Mulher” dedicado às colaboradoras, com ótima infraestrutura para prestação de serviços, eventos e descanso e que, também realiza campeonato de futebol em quadra society, com arbitragem profissional e com churrasco e cerveja na grande final? E se dissessem ainda, que a Toledo do Brasil incentiva que seus colaboradores participem de eventos culturais , fornecendo ingressos gratuitos para orquestras, teatros e concertos internacionais no Brasil.

Imaginou? Então vamos lá! Queremos te convidar a fazer parte dessa grande família e, como em toda a família, a sinceridade e transparência são os principais pilares. Bom, antes de dizer como fazer parte desta família, gostaríamos de ressaltar que a empresa tem mais de 60 anos de história. Fundada em 1956, a empresa sempre esteve em processo de transformação de sua cultura organizacional, de seus produtos e de sua marca para acompanhar a grande e bem‑vinda evolução da sociedade. E para que essa evolução seja ainda melhor e mais completa, gostaríamos de contar com o seu apoio, com as suas histórias, com as suas experiências e com seu conhecimento para tornar o ambiente interno cada vez mais interessante, inteligente e familiar.

Então, agora que já conhece um pouco sobre a Toledo do Brasil, coloque tudo na balança e entre nessa jornada! Afinal, aqui não te faltarão desafios, aprendizados, interação e conquistas com as diversas áreas da empresa.

ATIVIDADES:

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.

Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
  • Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
  • Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
  • Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.

Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe

  • Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores.
  • Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
  • Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.

ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO:

  • Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa).
  • Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
  • Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL:

  • Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

Missão do cargo

Descrição de cargo

  • Participar de reuniões de briefing com a coordenação sobre o planejamento da operação que será realizada, a fim de conhecer os procedimentos, recursos, orientações e esclarecer eventuais dúvidas.

  • Apoiar e/ou executar a montagem e teste dos equipamentos com base nos procedimentos da TechnipFMC e clientes, utilizando os recursos necessários, a fim de dar início às operações.
  • Apoiar e/ou executar a operação de equipamentos, conforme procedimentos operacionais, normas de segurança, visando atender as demandas da TechnipFMC e de clientes.
  • Realizar a elaboração dos relatórios semanais de apontamentos (weekly reports) no sharepoint, sobre as atividades realizadas em todos os dias, conforme os requisitos estabelecidos de prazos e conteúdo, a fim de garantir o fornecimento de informações para controle de folgas, pagamento de adicionais e custo do setor.

  • Preencher e/ou auxiliar no preenchimento dos relatórios/boletins diários, informando todas as etapas das operações, anomalias ocorridas durante o processo, visando manter a TechnipFMC e o cliente informados sobre o status operacional.
  • Controlar todos os sobressalentes (peças, ferramentas) e equipamentos a bordo, por meio de relatórios, visando o encaminhamento da informação para a Coordenação e cliente.
  • Contribuir na elaboração de relatórios de campo, contendo todas as informações do embarque, contempladas com todo o nível de detalhe, a fim de encaminhar para a Coordenação e cliente.

  • Formação técnica em Química. (somente em química)
  • CFT ativo.
  • Experiência prévia em operação de planta de processo, refinaria, petroquímicas e/ou manutenção e diagnóstico de sistemas.
  • Experiência em monitoramento de planta de processo por meio de software.
  • Noções de termodinâmica, separação de líquidos e conceitos básicos de instrumentação.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de processo. Experiência em separação de fases, bombeamento e controle de fluxo são desejáveis.
  • Experiência com análise de causa e efeito.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e ajustar parâmetros operacionais com base em dados de campo.
  • Aptidão em realizar manobras em válvulas e sistemas de processo.
  • Acompanhar parâmetros operacionais e aplicar ações corretivas.
  • Conhecimento em Flow Assurance (hidratos, emulsões, incrustações, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle e instrumentação.

Engenheiro de Dados Especialista | BigQuery

Dadoteca Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Dados Especialista | BigQuery role at Dadoteca

Resumo da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com experiência sólida em BigQuery, Airflow e desenvolvimento de ETLs estruturados em arquitetura por camadas (raw, staging e curated).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por construir, automatizar e otimizar pipelines de dados de alta performance, garantindo confiabilidade, governança e disponibilidade das informações para uso analítico e tomadas de decisão.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e robustos, utilizando BigQuery e Airflow.
  • Estruturar e organizar dados em arquitetura por camadas (raw, staging, curated), seguindo boas práticas de engenharia e governança.
  • Criar processos de ingestão, transformação e modelagem (ETL/ELT) com foco em performance, rastreabilidade e eficiência.
  • Automatizar fluxos de dados, agendamentos e monitoramento via Airflow, garantindo disponibilidade e recuperação rápida de falhas.
  • Realizar otimização de consultas SQL, particionamento, clustering e boas práticas de organização no BigQuery.
  • Atuar no suporte ao ambiente, acompanhando performance, consumo, custos e integrações entre sistemas.
  • Documentar processos, arquiteturas e padrões operacionais, garantindo clareza e fácil manutenção.
  • Realizar repasse de conhecimento para equipes técnicas e de negócio, promovendo autonomia e melhor uso dos dados.
  • Colaborar com times de Analytics, Produto, BI e Engenharia para alinhar necessidades e entregar soluções eficientes.

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com BigQuery (desenvolvimento, tuning, particionamento, clusterização).
  • Forte domínio em Airflow para orquestração, automação e monitoramento de pipelines.
  • Experiência com ETL/ELT em arquitetura por camadas:
    • Raw (bronze)
    • Staging (silver)
    • Curated (gold)
  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, otimização, funções, CTEs).
  • Experiência com Python para scripts, operadores e integrações no Airflow.
  • Práticas de versionamento (Git) e documentação técnica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com GCP além de BigQuery (Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer).
  • Conhecimento em modelagens para análise (dimensional, data vault, star schema).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Vivência com custos e controle de billing em BigQuery.
  • Boas práticas de CI/CD para pipelines de dados.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Proatividade e autonomia para investigar e resolver problemas complexos.

title: AGENTE DE OPERAÇÕES LEVES - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país.

Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados, no varejo e atacado. A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work.

Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”. Empoderamos as pessoas do nosso time e investimos no aprendizado diário e desenvolvimento contínuo. Aqui, cada Unilover é responsável por sua carreira e a leva para onde quiser. Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser? #VemPraUnidas

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Realizar inventários no pátio;
  • Levar os carros para higienização e abastecimento;
  • Realizar recebimento dos carros na retirada e devolução dos clientes;
  • Conferir checklist do veículo, visando contribuir para elevar a qualidade da frota disponível para aluguel e a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Avaliar as condições mecânicas dos veículos, acessórios, documentos etc.;
  • Apoiar na movimentação dos carros entre as lojas, quando necessário;
  • Organizar e otimizar o espaço físico dos carros no pátio e garantir a exposição de veículos de uma forma organizada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Pacote Office (Básico);
  • Obrigatório CNH (Categoria B);
  • Ter habilidade na direção de veículos leves;
  • Ter conhecimento básico com mecânica;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no formato 100% presencial, escala 6x1. Que tenha disponibilidade de horário para troca de escalas.

Informações adicionais

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Cartão Farmácia;
  • WellHub;
  • Clube de Vantagens;
  • Cartão flex;
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados.

Na Unidas, acreditamos que carreira é jornada , não destino . Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas , com soluções completas que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos.

Mas o que realmente nos move são as pessoas .

Somos um time que se movimenta em um único sentido: simplificar a vida dos nossos clientes com soluções completas, inovação em aluguel de ativos e serviços confiáveis . Esse é o nosso destino — e a nossa cultura é o veículo que nos leva até lá.

Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo , o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual . Acreditamos que cada talento tem o poder de transformar realidades — e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer.

Unidades de atuação

  • Unidas Aluguel de Carros: mobilidade sob medida para pessoas e empresas.
  • Unidas Livre: assinatura de veículos 0km com praticidade e liberdade.
  • Unidas Frotas: gestão inteligente de frotas leves e pesadas.
  • Unidas Pesados: soluções robustas para os setores agrícola, de mineração e construção.
  • Unidas Seminovos: veículos com procedência e ótimo custo-benefício.

Por que escolher a Unidas para sua carreira?

  • Cultura de protagonismo e colaboração.
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação.
  • Ambiente que valoriza a diversidade e inclusão.
  • Desafios reais com impacto direto nos negócios.
  • Oportunidades em diferentes regiões e áreas de atuação.

Fazemos parte de algo maior. A Unidas integra o portfólio da Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser e busca um lugar onde possa crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação, a Unidas é a sua caminho certo.

Aqui, sua carreira tem direção, propósito e movimento.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
Participar dadefinição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
Atendimento àfiscalização e auditoria;
Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária. Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;

comprehensive due diligence, and investment execution, specifically within renewable energy project portfolios.- Extensive experience globally in structuring and financing renewable energy projects
